model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The chart illustrates the absolute mean values of three distinct hidden state metrics across successive layers in a neural network architecture. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” represents the layer index, ranging from 0 to 22 in increments of 1, with numerical tick marks displayed at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” denotes the absolute mean value, scaled linearly from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1 unit. 

The first line, colored blue with a dashed style and circular markers, represents the “hidden state mean before gate,” with an average value of 0.71. It begins near 0.0 at layer 0, fluctuates slightly upward to approximately 0.3 at layer 5, remains relatively flat near 0.2 through layer 15, then rises to about 0.9 at layer 20, and sharply increases to approximately 4.3 at layer 22.

The second line, colored orange with a dotted style and circular markers, corresponds to the “hidden state mean after gate,” with an average value of 0.05. It starts near 0.0 at layer 0, remains nearly flat at approximately 0.02 through layer 20, and ends near 0.04 at layer 22.

The third line, colored green with a solid style and circular markers, indicates the “hidden state mean of baseline,” with an average value of 0.04. It begins near 0.0 at layer 0, remains nearly flat at approximately 0.01 through layer 20, and ends near 0.03 at layer 22.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表展示了在不同层（Layer）中三种隐藏状态均值（Abs Mean）的对比，x轴表示层索引，从0到25，刻度为线性间隔，单位为层；y轴表示绝对均值，范围从0到4，刻度为线性间隔，单位为无量纲。图中包含三条线：蓝色虚线代表“隐藏状态门之前均值”，其平均值为0.71，在x=0时约为0.05，随层增加缓慢上升，在x=25时急剧上升至约4.2；橙色点划线代表“隐藏状态门之后均值”，其平均值为0.05，在x=0时约为0.01，整体保持在0.01至0.03之间波动，变化平缓；绿色实线代表“基线隐藏状态均值”，其平均值为0.04，在x=0时约为0.01，整体维持在0.01至0.02之间波动，变化极小。
model_annotations.English: This line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the absolute mean values of three distinct hidden state metrics across layers in a neural network architecture. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to 25 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, representing the sequential depth of the network layers. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4 and uses a linear scale to quantify the absolute mean of the respective hidden state values. The plot contains three distinct lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at approximately 0.0, rises gradually to about 0.4, then increases more steeply to a final value of approximately 4.3 at layer 25; an orange dotted line with circular markers for the "hidden state mean after gate," which remains consistently low throughout, averaging around 0.05 and ending near 0.07; and a green solid line with circular markers for the "hidden state mean of baseline," which stays nearly flat near 0.04 across all layers.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den absoluten Mittelwert der versteckten Zustände (Abs Mean) entlang der Schichten (Layer) eines neuronalen Netzwerks, wobei drei verschiedene Messwerte verglichen werden: der Mittelwert der versteckten Zustände vor dem Gate (blau, durchgezogen, avg 0.71), der Mittelwert nach dem Gate (orange, gestrichelt, avg 0.05) und der Mittelwert der Baseline (grün, durchgezogen, avg 0.04). Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Schichtnummer und ist linear skaliert von 0 bis 25, mit einem Intervall von 5 Einheiten zwischen den Tick-Markierungen. Die y-Achse zeigt den absoluten Mittelwert und ist linear skaliert von 0 bis 4, mit einem Intervall von 1 Einheit zwischen den Tick-Markierungen. Die blaue Linie beginnt bei etwa 0.05 bei Layer 0, bleibt im unteren Bereich bis etwa Layer 15, steigt dann leicht an und erreicht bei Layer 20 etwa 0.9, bevor sie abrupt auf über 4.0 ansteigt. Die orange Linie bleibt über den gesamten Bereich nahe bei 0.05 und zeigt kaum Variation. Die grüne Linie bleibt über den gesamten Bereich nahe bei 0.04 und zeigt ebenfalls kaum Variation.
